moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Finals Day
moments.blurb: The 100-ball cricket tournament, The Hundred, concludes its 2026 season with Finals Day at Lord's on Sunday, August 16th, featuring both men's and women's finals.

angles.name: Cricket Excitement
angles.copy: It all comes down to this! The Hundred Finals Day is Sunday, who are you backing to lift the trophy at Lord's?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus
angles.copy: Will Welsh Fire be making it to Finals Day? Catch all the action as The Hundred climaxes this Sunday!

moments.title: EFL Championship Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 English Football League season begins its opening round of matches this weekend, August 14-16, with teams across the Championship, League One, and League Two returning to action.

angles.name: Football's Back!
angles.copy: The wait is over! The EFL season kicks off this weekend. Who are you tipping for promotion?

angles.name: Wrexham's Championship Return
angles.copy: Wrexham are back in the Championship! The new season starts this weekend - are you ready for the ride?

moments.title: Super League Rugby Action This Week
moments.blurb: The Betfred Super League continues with a series of fixtures this week, including matches on Thursday, August 13th, Friday, August 14th, and Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Rugby League Rivals
angles.copy: Midweek and weekend Super League action is coming your way! Who's looking strong for the playoffs?

angles.name: Big Games Ahead
angles.copy: Don't miss a minute of the Super League this week! Plenty of big clashes to get stuck into.

moments.title: Premier League Season Around the Corner
moments.blurb: The Premier League 2026/27 season is set to kick off on Friday, August 21st, with fixtures already announced, building anticipation for the return of top-flight football.

angles.name: The Countdown Begins
angles.copy: Just over a week until the Premier League is back! Who's going to be your team's breakout star this season?

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: The Premier League fixtures are out and the countdown is on for August 21st. What game are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Celebrity Reveals
moments.blurb: Celebrity announcements are ongoing for the 2026 series of Strictly Come Dancing, with the launch show set to be pre-recorded on September 9th and broadcast on September 19th.

angles.name: Strictly Stars Unveiled
angles.copy: More names are dropping for Strictly Come Dancing 2026! Who's your dream celebrity and pro pairing this year?

angles.name: Get Ready to Rumba
angles.copy: The Strictly ballroom is getting ready! We're hearing all the celebrity gossip before the launch next month. Who are you excited for?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returning Soon
moments.blurb: Season 16 of The Great British Bake Off is confirmed to start on Channel 4 on September 2nd, with the line-up of amateur bakers being unveiled.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: The tent is almost open! The Great British Bake Off returns September 2nd. What bakes are you hoping to see this year?

angles.name: New Batch of Bakers
angles.copy: Get ready for a fresh batch of bakers! The Great British Bake Off is just around the corner, bringing back our favourite comfort TV.

moments.title: Perseid Meteor Shower Peaks
moments.blurb: The annual Perseid meteor shower, one of the most spectacular of the year, is expected to peak around August 12-13, offering a chance to see numerous shooting stars.

angles.name: Night Sky Spectacle
angles.copy: Look up! The Perseid meteor shower peaks this week, offering a stunning display of shooting stars. Find a dark spot and enjoy the show!

angles.name: Stargazing Alert
angles.copy: Clear skies mean prime viewing for the Perseid meteor shower over the next couple of nights. Who's staying up to catch a glimpse?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Approaching
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festivals are just a few weeks away, running from August 27th-30th, with a huge lineup including Charli XCX, Chase & Status, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., and RAYE.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds are just around the corner! Who are you most excited to see on the lineup this year?

angles.name: Big Names, Big Weekend
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday weekend means Reading & Leeds! Get ready for an epic few days of music with some massive headliners.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Kurtis Blow
moments.blurb: Today marks the 67th birthday of pioneering American rapper and producer Kurtis Blow, known for hits like 'The Breaks'.

angles.name: Hip Hop Legend
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to hip-hop pioneer Kurtis Blow, turning 67 today! 'The Breaks' is still an absolute classic.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Barbara Mason
moments.blurb: American R&B and soul singer Barbara Mason, famous for 'Yes, I'm Ready', celebrates her 79th birthday today.

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 79th Birthday to the incredible Barbara Mason! Her timeless hit 'Yes, I'm Ready' still sounds as good as ever.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Michael Bivins
moments.blurb: Michael Bivins, member of New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe, turns 58 tomorrow, August 10th.

angles.name: New Jack Swing Star
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're celebrating the birthday of Michael Bivins from New Edition and Bell Biv DeVoe, turning 58!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joe Jackson
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter Joe Jackson, known for 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?' and 'Steppin' Out', celebrates his 71st birthday on August 11th.

angles.name: New Wave Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 71st Birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson, celebrating on Tuesday! What's your favourite Joe Jackson track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Roy Hay
moments.blurb: Roy Hay, guitarist and keyboardist for the iconic 80s band Culture Club, turns 65 on Wednesday, August 12th.

angles.name: Culture Club Co-founder
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to Culture Club's Roy Hay on Wednesday! Boy George might be the face, but Roy's guitar work is pure 80s magic.

moments.title: Happy Birthday James Morrison
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter James Morrison, known for his soulful voice and hits like 'You Give Me Something', celebrates his 42nd birthday on Thursday, August 13th.

angles.name: Soulful Singer-Songwriter
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 42nd Birthday to the fantastic James Morrison, celebrating on Thursday!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joe Jonas
moments.blurb: Joe Jonas, pop star from the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, will celebrate his 37th birthday on Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Jonas Brother Turns 37
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Joe Jonas of the Jonas Brothers turns 37 this Saturday. What's your favourite JoBros hit?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Tom Johnston
moments.blurb: Tom Johnston, lead singer, guitarist, and songwriter for The Doobie Brothers, celebrates his 78th birthday on Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Doobie Brothers Legend
angles.copy: Sending rock 'n' roll birthday wishes to The Doobie Brothers' frontman Tom Johnston, turning 78 on Saturday! Play 'Listen to the Music' loud!
